title: The normalized etale Weil realization functor is fully faithful
statement: Fix a prime $l$, an algebraic closure $Q$ of $\mathbf Q_l$, a connected Noetherian separated scheme $Y$ on which $l$ is invertible, a geometric point $t$, and an automorphism $h:Y\simeq Y$. Use the actual etale lisse algebraic coefficient category and $h^*$ of [def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves, def-wf-lisse-adic-automorphism-pullback]. Let $G$ be a group with degree datum $d$, and let $D$ identify the geometric fundamental group at $t$ with $\ker d$ and supply the normalized path to $h(t)$ as in [def-wf-fundamental-representation, sk-d-real-weil]. There is an explicitly defined functor from etale lisse Weil sheaves to the category of [new-p6-etale-weil-representation-data]. Its object is the actual stalk carrying the fundamental action of [def-wf-fundamental-representation], and its arrow is the normalized stalk intertwiner of [new-p6-etale-weil-fiber-hom]. This functor is fully faithful. Its map on arrows is exactly the prescribed etale stalk map.

proof.text: Choose the Hom dictionary uniquely fixed by its underlying stalk map. Send an object to Rep.of its normalized fundamental representation, whose geometric restriction is l-adic. Send an arrow to the dictionary intertwiner. Equality of underlying linear maps proves identity and composition, using functoriality of the etale fibre map. The inverse Hom equivalence supplies a FullyFaithful structure and its two inverse identities.
